Your brain reads tone into texts the way a smoke alarm reads toast — it can't tell the difference between real danger and missing punctuation. The Signal Check helps you separate signal from noise.

The Signal Check is from the free 7-Day Overthinking Detox — DM "DETOX" to get it.
